text_block_list.text:
I did it...! I really did it!
How was that, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Was I... being the main character just now!?
choice_data_list: Yeah! You looked so incredibly cool!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe...♪
But I shouldn't just be satisfied with this, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Our story isn't over yet! We've gotta hype things up even more from here on out!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Friendship, effort, victory!
I'll make our next race just like that!"

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Worrying a lot, working super hard, and grasping victory in the end! That's the kind of Umamusume I want to be!
